mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diet_recommendation_history ( user_id, session_id, trace_id, source_mode, source_strategy, user_input, slots_json, speech_text, meals_json, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{traceId}, #{sourceMode}, #{sourceStrategy}, #{userInput}, #{slotsJson}, #{speechText}, #{mealsJson}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, session_id, trace_id, source_mode, source_strategy, user_input, slots_json, speech_text, meals_json, created_at FROM diet_recommendation_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND created_at >= CURRENT_DATE() AND created_at < DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
